title: D₅ sphere-packing optimality conjecture
statement: The D₅ root-lattice density is optimal among unit-sphere packings in Euclidean dimension five.

counterexample.description: A positive-definite rational 5×5 Gram matrix whose lattice has minimum squared norm at least four and determinant strictly below 128. This is a unit-sphere lattice packing denser than scaled D₅.
